prerequisites: Theoretical and practical basic knowledge of mathematics and physics
Mandatory Electrical Engineering and Electronics course
Positive completion of the StEOP (Study Introduction and Orientation Phase)

learning_outcomes.text: To systematically present relevant fundamentals of electrical engineering and electronics for application-oriented engineering uses.
To methodically work on problem statements in the mentioned subject areas.
To thoroughly analyze and solve simple electrical engineering tasks.
To independently apply the taught methods of electrical engineering and electronics for application-oriented engineering uses.
To systematically investigate the operating behavior of electrical machines in typical operating modes.
To appropriately perform electrical measurement techniques.
To clearly explain the fundamentals of digital technology.
To suitably select power electronic components and circuits for given requirements.
To confidently apply the fundamentals of electrical drive technology to practical examples.
To systematically investigate assumptions, risks, and boundary conditions in technical tasks.
To critically compare alternatives of measurement, evaluation, and documentation procedures based on defined criteria.
To present technical content, decisions, and results in an audience-appropriate manner.
To clearly explain one's own solution approaches, measurement setups, and evaluation steps.
To plan work processes with time and resource planning both independently and cooperatively in a structured way.
To constructively discuss peer feedback on intermediate results and decisions.
To concisely summarize key statements, protocols, and decision templates.

syllabus_topics: Application of AC circuit analysis in time and frequency domain
Structure and operating behavior of electrical machines
teaching_methods: Lectures on theoretical fundamentals and methods
Illustration of application through practice-oriented examples

assessment_methods.method: Written and/or oral examination with calculation examples and theory questions

assessment_rules: The examination modalities are to be specified in the information system for studies and teaching for each course before the start of the semester.
